title: MSG91 /api/v5/otp response — fields MSG91Client.send_otp consumes
description: MSG91's /api/v5/otp returns HTTP 200 for both success AND some silent failure modes. The 'type' field is the only reliable success/fail indicator. See reference_msg91_otp_gotchas.md + SVC-460.

type.description: 'success' on actual delivery; 'error' when MSG91 ate the request silently.
